summary: POST-certified patrol officer with over a decade of experience in municipal and federal law enforcement, specializing in emergency response, criminal investigation, and community-oriented policing. Proven record of de-escalating crises, enforcing traffic and criminal statutes, and producing accurate incident documentation.

experience.title: Police Officer (Patrol)
bullets: Patrol designated sectors to detect law violators, issue citations, and make arrests, averaging 14 traffic stops and 3 custodial arrests per week while maintaining a complaint rate below 2%.
Respond to emergency calls for service including domestic disturbances, traffic collisions, and medical crises, rendering first aid and coordinating with EMS until transport.
Investigate suspicious activities and illegal conduct, interviewing witnesses and suspects, reviewing incident facts, and determining applicable statute violations before filing charges.
Prepare detailed incident and arrest reports documenting facts, evidence, and legal charges; reports are routinely cited by prosecutors for accuracy and completeness.
Engage in community relations activities including neighborhood meetings, school presentations, and business security consultations to strengthen public trust.

experience.title: Police Officer (Patrol)

experience.title: Police Officer (Patrol)
bullets: Patrolled state highways and rural areas to enforce motor vehicle and criminal laws, issuing citations and making arrests for impaired driving, drug possession, and warrant service.
